translation_direction: zh → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Chinese electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: The classical-Chinese preface is rendered in terse Hán-Việt-tinged Vietnamese; the diary in plain, halting vernacular.
decisions.rationale: Lu Xun’s frame depends on the contrast between the doctor-like editor and the madman.

decisions.decision: Names and allusions in Hán-Việt (Triệu Quý, Cổ Cửu, Lang Tử, Dịch Nha, Kiệt Trụ, Từ Tích Lâm, Bản thảo), with the madman’s historical confusions left uncorrected.
decisions.rationale: Faithful to the source without explanatory notes.

decisions.decision: 『』 rendered as “ ”; six-dot ellipses and double dashes normalised to … and —.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: The evolution speech reversed the comparison (the cannibals’ shame said to be smaller than the worms’ before the monkeys); now far greater, as in the source.
The 不能 pun restored as ‘không được’ in both the madman’s plea and the brother’s refusal of the tenants; 要好 aligned with 1.55.
趕緊喫罷 keeps its double reading (medicine / eating) as ‘Cho dùng ngay đi!’; 意外 and 古來 corrected (1.18).
狼子 as lũ sói con echoing Lang Tử; ledger, ages, sister’s death, ‘cùng một bọn’ and other calques corrected.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: One rendering for every occurrence, including the words read between the lines of the history book.
The villagers’ formula and the madman’s retort «從來如此，便對麼？» keep the same words.

glossary.draft_rendering: người thật; Hãy cứu lấy trẻ em…
glossary.rationale: The established Vietnamese wording of the closing appeal.

witness_decision: Selected the Chinese Wikisource transclusion «狂人日記» (revision 2605391) of 魯迅全集 vol. 1 (1938 edition, 1948 printing), Page namespace pages 298–312; fourteen pages are marked proofread (level 3) and one validated (level 4). First published in 新青年 vol. 4 no. 5 (May 1918) and collected in 吶喊 (1923); not collated with the 1918 magazine text.

unresolved_questions.explanation: 海乙那 (hyena) kept as the transliteration Hải Ất Na without a note, as the madman’s strange borrowed word.

title_review.rationale: Nhật ký người điên is the established Vietnamese title; the preface notes that the diarist named it himself after his recovery.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Classical preface rendered in a terse Hán-Việt register.
